title: Disha Patani Visits Tiger Shroff as Police Form 15 Teams After Juhu Firing
excerpt: First photos show the actor with a bandaged arm and dressings after Sunday's shooting, though police say he took no bullet injury. A Bishnoi gang claim remains unverified, and 15 police teams are investigating.
body:
• Disha Patani visited Tiger Shroff at his Mumbai residence late on Sunday night, hours after three motorcycle-borne men fired at his car in Juhu.
  • The first photographs of Shroff after the attack, taken during Deputy Chief Minister Eknath Shinde's visit, show a bandaged arm and dressings on his chest and shoulder. Police say he sustained no gunshot injury, and Shinde attributed injuries on his left hand to gunpowder and shards of glass.
  • Mumbai Police have formed 15 teams, including Crime Branch personnel, and registered an FIR against unidentified persons. A social media post claiming responsibility in the Lawrence Bishnoi gang's name has not been verified by police.
  • Shroff's driver Firdaus, who was injured in the hand, is out of danger, police said. The second injured man, an autorickshaw driver identified as Chauhan, remains under treatment.

Actor Disha Patani was seen arriving at Tiger Shroff's residence late on Sunday night, hours after gunmen opened fire on his car in Mumbai's Juhu area, according to an IANS report. Patani, dressed in a white sleeveless top and loose light-blue jeans, looked visibly worried as she stepped out of her car and went inside, the report said. Shroff's Baaghi 2 co-star was among the first from the film industry to reach the actor's home as news of the firing spread.

The attack took place at around 7 p.m. on Sunday near Pushpa Park in Juhu, as Shroff was leaving after a football game. Three men on a motorcycle allegedly fired at his car before fleeing. Shroff was escorted home under police protection.

First Photos, and What Officials Say About His Injuries

The first photographs of Shroff after the incident emerged from his meeting with Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister Eknath Shinde, who visited the actor at his residence. The pictures show bandages on his arm and dressings on his chest and shoulder, according to IANS and MensXP. Mumbai Police, however, have maintained that the actor was not hit by a bullet. "Mr. Tiger Shroff did not sustain any gunshot injuries; he is completely safe," Deputy Commissioner of Police Mohit Garg said, in remarks carried by ANI and reported by The Daily Jagran.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=W0Rh34CtL_A

"Tiger Shroff did not sustain any gunshot injuries; he is completely safe," Deputy Commissioner of Police Mohit Garg said, in remarks carried by ANI and reported by The Daily Jagran ."

Shinde offered the only official explanation so far for the visible dressings. "I met with the actor; he has injuries on his left hand caused by gunpowder and shards of glass," he said, adding that Shroff and his mother were "quite shaken" and that no form of threat would be tolerated. The actor's father, Jackie Shroff, confirmed his son was unharmed and was assisting officials at the police station, Jagran reported. Garg said driver Firdaus, injured in his left hand, was out of danger, while Chauhan, the autorickshaw driver caught in the firing, was still undergoing treatment.

15 Police Teams and an FIR

Mumbai Police have constituted 15 teams, including dedicated personnel from the Crime Branch and local police, to investigate the case and track down the culprits, a police official told Jagran. A forensic team has collected ballistic evidence from the spot and is examining CCTV footage from the surrounding area to establish the number of assailants and rounds fired. An FIR has been registered against unidentified individuals under Sections 109 and 3(5) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and Section 25 of the Arms Act, according to MensXP. Jagran also reported that one accused had been arrested, though police had not released details of any arrest in the statements cited in these reports.

https://x.com/ANI/status/2111922853771952187

An Unverified Claim in the Bishnoi Gang's Name

Shortly after the shooting, a social media post attributed to Anil Pandit and Harman Sandhu claimed responsibility for the attack in the name of the Lawrence Bishnoi gang. The post alleged that Shroff had been warned by phone earlier and was targeted over working with Salman Khan, and warned that others who collaborated with Khan would also be targeted. Police have not verified the authenticity of the post or established any link between the gang and the shooting, and investigators say the motive remains unconfirmed.

Chief Minister Orders Immediate Action

Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis spoke to Mumbai Police Commissioner Deven Bharti and directed him to expedite the investigation and take strict action, and also spoke to Shroff by phone. "We are all with you. We will track down the accused soon. Do not worry," Fadnavis, who also holds the Home portfolio, told the actor, according to the Chief Minister's Office. Shinde said he had likewise spoken to the Police Commissioner and assured the family of the state government's support. The investigation is continuing.
